subject: POC kickoff + load testing / benchmarking session — scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Chris Johnson <chris.johnson@greengrid.ai>, Aditi Sharma <aditi@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff + load testing / benchmarking session — scheduling

Hi Chris / Aditi,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a hands-on POC with Redwood. To get the ball rolling we'd like to schedule a 90-minute kickoff + working session next week where we'll: 
- Walk through the POC plan and goals (integration points, datasets)
- Do a prompt review and routing config walkthrough
- Run an initial load testing plan and review acceptance targets

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-05-26 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-05-27 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2026-05-28 09:00–10:30

I've attached a short agenda and the preliminary load test plan for you to review ahead of time. Dev and Rishi — I'm looping you in to help with the test harness and model selection.

High-level throughput/latency targets Greengrid mentioned: 200 req/s sustained; 95th percentile latency <250ms for single-turn generation at 512 tokens. We'll confirm feasibility during the session.

Please let me know which window works best and any constraints on lab access / test data.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: POC_Agenda_20260520.pdf, load_test_plan_greengrid.xlsx
From: Chris Johnson <chris.johnson@greengrid.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Aditi Sharma <aditi@greengrid.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + load testing / benchmarking session — scheduling

Hey Marissa,

Thanks — really excited to get started. The team is available next week but Tue morning is rough for us because of our sprint planning. Wed 14:00–15:30 PDT looks best.

A few quick notes: 
- We can provide a staging API key and a subset of production-like payloads (I'll share before the session).
- Our infra team will want to observe the load test; can you confirm the test harness you plan to use and whether it supports TLS mutual auth?
- The throughput target is aggressive for our current capacity; if possible, can we start with a ramp to 200 req/s and capture p95 and p99?

I'll accept a calendar invite for Wed if you send one.

—Chris
Chris Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering, Greengrid, Inc.
chris.johnson@greengrid.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Chris Johnson <chris.johnson@greengrid.ai>, Aditi Sharma <aditi@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + load testing / benchmarking session — scheduling

Perfect — Wed 2026-05-27 14:00–15:30 PDT is reserved. Sending an invite now.

Answers inline: 
- Test harness: we'll use our lightweight k6-based harness that runs from a customer-observed runner. It supports mTLS and can be configured to use your staging certs. Dev — can you prepare a quick README for cert setup?
- Ramp plan: we'll run a stepped ramp (10 -> 50 -> 100 -> 200 req/s over ~20 minutes), capture throughput, p50/p95/p99, and error rates. We'll also profile tail latency and GPU utilization on Redwood's side.
- Model variants: we'll plan to run your preferred model variant and a quantized variant to compare cost/latency. Rishi, please prepare the model switch demo.

Laura — can you own post-session follow-ups and test-data ingestion?

Attaching the updated load_test_plan_greengrid.xlsx with the ramp schedule and measurement matrix.

Thanks — invite sent.
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Chris Johnson <chris.johnson@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + load testing / benchmarking session — scheduling

Thanks Marissa. A couple quick clarifying questions before Wed: 
1) Chris — will the staging endpoint require mutual TLS or is token-based auth fine for the initial ramp? We can support both but need certs earlier for full mTLS tests.
2) Can you share an example payload size distribution? We'll need small/median/large examples to tune batching and sequence-length costs.

I'll prepare the k6 job and a short README for cert import; planning to push the harness to the shared Drive folder you referenced.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.inference.com

Hi team,

We can do token-based auth for the initial ramp; we'll provide certs by EOD Monday if you need mTLS for the final test. I've uploaded example_payloads.json to the Drive folder (small/medium/large). Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleLinkLoadTests

Chris and I have accepted the Wed invite. See you then.

Best,
Aditi

Great — thanks everyone. Final checklist ahead of Wed: 
- Greengrid: staging API key + (optional) mTLS certs in Drive by Mon EOD (Aditi noted).
- Dev/Rishi: k6 harness + README in Drive by Tue noon.
- Laura: calendar invite & meeting notes template (please include acceptance criteria and follow-up owners).

Agenda (attached): kickoff goals, integration steps, prompt review, routing config, ramped load test, results review + next steps.

If anything changes, ping me or swap on the calendar. Looking forward to it.

-Marissa
